summary: MUAC color code not set for patients aged exactly 5, 10, or 18
description:
In getMuacColorCode (packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/vitals-biometrics-form.utils.ts), the age-bracket boundary conditions are inconsistent between color cases within the same bracket.
For example, in the 0-5 age bracket, the "red" case uses age <= 5, but the "yellow" and "green" cases use age < 5. This means a patient exactly 5 years old with a healthy MUAC value (e.g. 13cm) gets no color code at all.
More critically, patients exactly 10 or 18 years old get NO color code set for ANY MUAC value, because:
The "5-10" bracket uses age > 5 && age < 10 (excludes 10)

The "10-18" bracket uses age > 10 && age < 18 (excludes both 10 and 18)

The "18+" bracket uses age > 18 (excludes 18)

Verified via unit test: calling getMuacColorCode(10, 20, callback) or getMuacColorCode(18, 20, callback) never invokes the callback, regardless of MUAC value.
Fix: make all brackets consistently inclusive on the lower bound (age <= 5, age > 5 && age <= 10, age > 10 && age <= 18, age > 18), so there's no gap at the boundary ages. Fix + regression tests ready; full esm-patient-vitals-app test suite (72 tests) passes.
